verdict.rationale: Notte documents an official MCP server that lets agents start cloud browser sessions, interact with pages, fetch data and build scripts, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page. First-party integration guides show CrewAI and Vercel AI SDK agents connecting to it as MCP clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and detailed evidence of setup/auth steps and the full tool list.
